slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: Too vague. You get a bland summary and miss the real problem.
slides.right:
Ask one specific
question at a time.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Prep your data
slides.card: Columns: date, product, units, revenue. Here are the rows: [paste, no names or IDs]
slides.note: Remove names, emails and IDs first.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: What changed?
slides.card: Compare this month to last month. What went up, what went down, and by how much?

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Find the odd ones
slides.card: Which rows look unusual or don't fit the pattern? List them and say why.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Ask for 3 actions
slides.card: Based on this, give me 3 actions for next week. Say which number backs each one.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Check the math
slides.card: List every figure you used and the formula to check it in my sheet.
slides.note: Never act on a number you haven't checked.

slides.headline: Save this for your next review.

scenes.headline:
Set it once.
AI does it every Monday.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Every Monday at 8:00, send me a short briefing on [my industry]: 5 news items, why each matters for my business, and 1 idea to act on this week. Under 150 words.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.footer: Check the first result. Then tweak.

scenes.note: Plan limits vary. Check what yours includes.
